title: Router output (STANDARD §1a)
description: The only thing a fellow→harness router may emit before a run starts. agentId selects the agent; input must then validate against that agent's typed input schema. Half-filled or schema-invalid payloads must not start a run.

agentId.description: Must match an agent.id known to the registry / input-schema map.

input.description: Typed payload for the selected agent. Shape is per-agent, not global.

confidence.description: Optional. If present and low, validation treats the request as not ready to start (ask the fellow).

question.description: Optional clarifying question when the router cannot fill input confidently.
